programs.description: Rup is a happily married man who has a loving wife, Pushpa, and daughter, Tutu. However, things change for him when he gets into an accident that changes his life forever.
A comprehensive compilation of some of the best devotional songs by various artists in praise of the various gods and goddesses.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
Narsingh, a taxi driver, decides to return to his native place, but finds himself involved with a businessman en route, who is also a smuggler and human trafficker.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
Separated during their youth, Amit and Labanya reunite in their twilight years. However, complications arise when Amit's daughter falls in love with Labanya's nephew.
Punyo, an Agradani brahmin, is offered land and riches if he lays in front of the room where his wife delivers their baby. When the wife delivers a stillborn baby, Punyo swaps it with his own baby.
A tax collector is amused after seeing an ancient fort and decides to stay there. He later meets a woman in the fort and falls for her, but is shocked to discover that she is a spirit.
Kony, a poor but talented swimmer, and Khidda, her coach, must overcome several obstacles and beat social stigma to participate in the National Swimming Championship.

Daksha is blessed with a goddess as his daughter, Sati, who disobeys him and marries Shiva. Enraged, Daksha humiliates Shiva, after which Sati sacrifices herself, paving the way for chaos and destruction.
A company having about 100 vacant positions promises jobs to many people. However, problems arise when it receives over 30,000 applications, and the frustrated applicants rise in revolt.

An affluent girl with hearing-impairment falls for a lesser fortunate man with speech disability. They escape her father's attempt to get her married by force, enduring peril and difficulty through mutual reliance.
Shreemoyee calls off her wedding with Tapodhir after a political rally causes friction between them. However, her entry into the cutthroat realm of politics changes her life forever.
A terminally ill man doubts his wife's faithfulness, but realises regretfully that he was mistaken. She decides to forgive him, and puts on stage performances to fund his treatment.
